name: Ice Knife
material: a drop of water or piece of ice
description:
You create a shard of ice that explodes upon impact and fling it towards a creature. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 piercing damage. Use the same attack roll against the target and each creature within 5 ft. of the target. On a hit, they take 1d8 cold damage.

**At Higher Levels.** When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the cold damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1st.
